_note: Shape the Research: the priorities subscribers can put Cedar Points toward. The owner edits this file: titles, descriptions, type (research_question or dataset), status (interest, under_review, research_underway, data_construction_underway, published), published_output (a path or URL once something ships) and evolved_from (a research question that became a dataset, or the reverse). The service seeds and re-seeds its table from this file on start; points and subscriber counts live in the service's ledger and are never written here.

rules.note: A subscription earns its points the first time anyone on it signs in during a calendar month; a month without a sign-in earns nothing, and sign-ins after the first earn nothing more. Points expire twelve months after they were earned if unspent. Priorities are considered alongside feasibility, data quality, research value and Cedar's editorial judgment; points do not set the agenda mechanically.

priorities.title: How much revenue do tribal enterprises generate?
priorities.description: An estimate of the revenue of tribally owned enterprises, by sector and by owner, with the evidence behind it and the gaps stated.

priorities.title: How are tribes financing energy development?
priorities.description: The capital behind tribal energy projects: federal grants and loans, tax credits, private partners and tribal equity, project by project where the record allows.

priorities.title: How has federal funding composition changed by tribal nation?
priorities.description: For each nation, which programs and agencies the money comes from and how that mix has moved over the fiscal years Cedar covers.

priorities.title: What is happening with Native CDFI lending?
priorities.description: Lending volumes, products and borrowers across the certified Native CDFIs, and how the sector has grown.

priorities.title: Tribal enterprise ownership and subsidiary relationships
priorities.description: A more complete record of tribal enterprises, their subsidiaries, ownership changes and parent relationships, building on the Native Enterprises collection.

priorities.title: Tribal-state compact database
priorities.description: Gaming, tax, water and other compacts between tribes and states: the parties, the terms that can be stated, the dates and the documents.

priorities.title: Tribal energy project database
priorities.description: Energy projects on tribal lands or owned by tribes: technology, capacity, partners, financing and status.

priorities.title: Expand Deals backward to 2010
priorities.description: Extend the Indian Country Deals collection from its current floor back to 2010, with the same verification standard.

priorities.title: Add more tribal TERO and business directories
priorities.description: Harvest and reconcile more tribal employment rights office and business directories into the Native-owned business register.

priorities.title: Improve historical lobbying coverage
priorities.description: Close the gaps in pre-2008 Lobbying Disclosure Act filings and their attribution to Native entities.

priorities.title: Add lending and capital-market transactions
priorities.description: Loans, bonds and other capital-market transactions involving Native entities, from the sources that record them.
